tools.name: clean_text
tools.description: Clean supplied text deterministically without rewriting its meaning. Use for copied PDF text, Markdown/HTML artifacts, citations, spacing, or destination formatting; not OCR, file uploads, grammar correction, or AI-authorship detection. Preserves supported document structure unless a selected cleanu

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "free" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: clean_text · Private data: clean_text · Public sink: clean_text.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: clean_text · Private data: clean_text · Public sink: clean_text

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "clean_text" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Clean copied text while preserving headings, paragraphs, lists, quotations, emphasis, and intentional spacing. Supports PDF repair and destination-specific rendering." → after: "Clean supplied text deterministically without rewriting its meaning. Use for copied PDF text, Markdown/HTML artifacts, citations, spacing, or destination formatting; not OCR, file uploads, grammar correction, or AI-authorship detection. Preserves supported document structure unless a selected cleanu"

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
